mapper.select: SELECT TO_CHAR(R.BASE_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS baseDt, R.STK_CD AS stkCd, R.STK_NM AS stkNm, R.MKT_CD AS mktCd, M.MKT_CD AS listingMarket, R.CUR_PRICE AS curPrice, R.MON_OPEN_PRICE AS monOpenPrice, R.MA5 AS ma5, R.MA20 AS ma20, R.MA60 AS ma60, R.MA120 AS ma120, R.MA240 AS ma240, R.GOLDEN_YN AS goldenYn, R.MON_UP_YN AS monUpYn, R.MON_CHG_RATE AS monChgRate, R.TREND_STRENGTH AS trendStrength, R.AVG_TRD_VAL_20 AS avgTrdVal20, R.REC_YN AS recYn, R.REC_GRADE AS recGrade, R.REC_REASON AS recReason FROM TB_REC_SIGNAL R JOIN TB_STK_MASTER M ON M.STK_CD = R.STK_CD WHERE R.BASE_DT = TO_DATE(#{baseDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND R.STK_CD = #{stkCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND R.MKT_CD = #{mktCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
